C1.case_summary: A jacket was reported with a broken zip after delivery.

known_facts.value: The jacket arrived yesterday and the zip is broken. Can I return it?

evidence_links.claim: The customer reported a broken zip.
Damaged-item replies remain subject to human review.

C1.draft_reply: The damaged jacket can be referred for human return review under the supplied policy. This is not a refund approval, and the issue remains open for review.
C1.human_action_required: Confirm the delivery timestamp and review the proposed reply.

C2.case_summary: A jacket has a broken zip, but its delivery date is missing.

known_facts.value: The jacket has a broken zip. Can I return it?

evidence_links.claim: The delivery date is required to apply the two-day rule.

C2.draft_reply: Please provide the delivery date before Meridian Retail assesses whether the two-day reporting rule applies. A human support agent will review the request.
C2.human_action_required: Confirm the delivery date before the review continues.

C3.case_summary: A customer asked for resolution confirmation while the replacement request remains open.

known_facts.value: Please confirm that my issue is resolved.
Replacement request is still under review

evidence_links.claim: The customer asked for resolution confirmation.
An open issue must not be described as resolved.

C3.draft_reply: The issue record is still open, so the draft cannot confirm that the issue is resolved. A human support agent will review the request.
C3.human_action_required: Review the open replacement request and the proposed reply.
